fr.title: Au-dessus de 5 % : ce qu'un rendement du Trésor au plus haut depuis 19 ans signifie pour les taux hypothécaires et le marché immobilier

segments.src: When the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield climbs above 5%, the effects rarely stay in the bond market.
segments.tr: Lorsque le rendement de référence des obligations du Trésor à 10 ans dépasse 5 %, les effets restent rarement cantonnés au marché obligataire.

segments.src: They show up in monthly mortgage payments, in the listings that sit unsold, and in the spreadsheets of homebuilders deciding whether to break ground.
segments.tr: Ils se manifestent dans les mensualités hypothécaires, dans les annonces immobilières qui restent invendues et dans les feuilles de calcul des promoteurs qui décident ou non de lancer des travaux.

segments.src: With the yield hovering near levels not seen in roughly two decades, home loan rates are staying stubbornly elevated.
segments.tr: Le rendement oscillant près de niveaux inédits depuis environ deux décennies, les taux des prêts immobiliers restent obstinément élevés.

segments.src: Here is how that is squeezing buyers, sellers and builders heading into the fall.
segments.tr: Voici comment cela pèse sur les acheteurs, les vendeurs et les promoteurs à l'approche de l'automne.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not financial, investment or mortgage advice.
segments.tr: *Cet article est fourni à titre d'information générale uniquement et ne constitue pas un conseil financier, d'investissement ou en matière de prêt hypothécaire.

segments.src: Rates and market conditions change often, so check current figures with a licensed professional before making decisions.*
segments.tr: Les taux et les conditions du marché évoluant fréquemment, veuillez vérifier les chiffres actuels auprès d'un professionnel agréé avant de prendre toute décision.*

segments.src: ## Why the 10-year yield matters for mortgages
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le rendement à 10 ans compte pour les prêts immobiliers

segments.src: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate does not move in lockstep with the Federal Reserve's policy rate.
segments.tr: Le taux hypothécaire fixe à 30 ans n'évolue pas en tandem avec le taux directeur de la Réserve fédérale.

segments.src: It tends to track the 10-year Treasury yield instead.
segments.tr: Il a plutôt tendance à suivre le rendement du Trésor à 10 ans.

segments.src: Investors who buy mortgage-backed securities compare the return on those bonds with the safe return on government debt.
segments.tr: Les investisseurs qui achètent des titres adossés à des créances hypothécaires comparent le rendement de ces obligations avec le rendement sans risque de la dette souveraine.

segments.src: Lenders then price home loans to deliver a return above that benchmark.
segments.tr: Les prêteurs fixent ensuite le prix des prêts immobiliers pour offrir un rendement supérieur à cette référence.

segments.src: The gap between the two is called the mortgage spread.
segments.tr: L'écart entre les deux est appelé la marge hypothécaire.

segments.src: In calmer periods it has historically averaged somewhere around 1.7 percentage points.
segments.tr: En période plus calme, il s'est historiquement établi autour de 1,7 point de pourcentage.

segments.src: In recent years it has often been wider, because of interest-rate volatility and uncertainty about how quickly borrowers will refinance or move.
segments.tr: Ces dernières années, il a souvent été plus large en raison de la volatilité des taux d'intérêt et de l'incertitude quant à la rapidité avec laquelle les emprunteurs refinanceront ou déménageront.

segments.src: A higher Treasury yield plus a wider spread means a higher mortgage rate, even if the central bank holds its policy rate steady.
segments.tr: Un rendement du Trésor plus élevé associé à une marge plus large se traduit par un taux hypothécaire plus élevé, même si la banque centrale maintient son taux directeur inchangé.

segments.src: ## What is pushing yields up
segments.tr: ## Qu'est-ce qui pousse les rendements à la hausse

segments.src: Several forces tend to lift long-term yields at the same time:
segments.tr: Plusieurs forces ont tendance à faire grimper les rendements à long terme en même temps :

segments.src: - **Heavy government borrowing.** Large federal deficits mean more Treasury debt for investors to absorb, which can push up the yield needed to attract buyers.
segments.tr: - **Un emprunt public massif.** Des déficits fédéraux importants signifient une dette du Trésor plus importante à absorber pour les investisseurs, ce qui peut faire monter le rendement nécessaire pour attirer les acheteurs.

segments.src: - **Sticky inflation.** If price growth cools more slowly than expected, investors demand more compensation for holding long-term bonds.
segments.tr: - **Une inflation persistante.** Si la hausse des prix ralentit plus lentement que prévu, les investisseurs exigent une compensation plus élevée pour détenir des obligations à long terme.

segments.src: - **A "higher for longer" policy outlook.** When markets expect the Fed to keep rates elevated, longer-term yields adjust upward.
segments.tr: - **Des perspectives politiques de taux « plus élevés pour plus longtemps ».** Lorsque les marchés s'attendent à ce que la Fed maintienne ses taux à un niveau élevé, les rendements à long terme s'ajustent à la hausse.

segments.src: - **A larger term premium.** Investors may ask for extra yield to cover the risk of holding long-dated debt amid economic and political uncertainty.
segments.tr: - **Une prime de terme plus élevée.** Les investisseurs peuvent demander un rendement supplémentaire pour couvrir le risque de détenir des obligations à long terme dans un contexte d'incertitude économique et politique.

segments.src: No single factor explains the move, and analysts disagree about how much weight each one deserves.
segments.tr: Aucun facteur unique n'explique ce mouvement, et les analystes divergent sur le poids accordé à chacun d'eux.

segments.src: ## The squeeze on buyers
segments.tr: ## La pression sur les acheteurs

segments.src: For buyers, the arithmetic is unforgiving.
segments.tr: Pour les acheteurs, le calcul est impitoyable.

segments.src: Consider a $400,000 loan on a 30-year fixed mortgage, counting principal and interest only:
segments.tr: Prenons un prêt de 400 000 $ sur un emprunt hypothécaire fixe à 30 ans, en ne comptant que le principal et les intérêts :

segments.src: | Mortgage rate | Approx. monthly payment |
segments.tr: | Mortgage rate | Approx. monthly payment |

segments.src: Going from 3% to 7% adds close to $1,000 a month on the same loan.
segments.tr: Passer de 3 % à 7 % ajoute près de 1 000 $ par mois pour le même prêt.

segments.src: Taxes, insurance and maintenance come on top of that.
segments.tr: Les impôts, l'assurance et l'entretien s'ajoutent à cela.

segments.src: Many households that qualified comfortably a few years ago now find the numbers don't work, or they shop for a smaller home, a different neighborhood or a longer commute.
segments.tr: De nombreux ménages qui étaient facilement éligibles il y a quelques années constatent aujourd'hui que les chiffres ne concordent plus, ou se tournent vers un logement plus petit, un autre quartier ou un trajet plus long.

segments.src: Common responses among buyers include:
segments.tr: Les réactions courantes parmi les acheteurs incluent :

segments.src: - **Rethinking the budget.** Some buyers now plan around the monthly payment instead of the headline price.
segments.tr: - **La révision du budget.** Certains acheteurs planifient désormais en fonction de la mensualité plutôt que du prix affiché.

segments.src: - **Larger down payments.** Putting more money down reduces the loan amount and the interest paid over time.
segments.tr: - **Des apports personnels plus importants.** Verser une mise de fonds plus élevée réduit le montant du prêt et les intérêts payés au fil du temps.

segments.src: - **Adjustable-rate mortgages.** These offer lower initial rates but carry the risk of higher payments later. Borrowers should read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - **Les prêts à taux variable.** Ceux-ci offrent des taux initiaux plus bas mais comportent le risque de mensualités plus élevées par la suite. Les emprunteurs doivent lire attentivement les conditions.

segments.src: - **Waiting.** Some renters are staying put until rates ease, though waiting has its own costs if prices or rents keep rising.
segments.tr: - **L'attentisme.** Certains locataires restent en place jusqu'à ce que les taux baissent, bien que l'attente ait un coût si les prix ou les loyers continuent d'augmenter.

segments.src: ## The "lock-in effect" and sellers
segments.tr: ## L'« effet de blocage » et les vendeurs

segments.src: Rates also affect the people who already own homes.
segments.tr: Les taux touchent également les propriétaires actuels.

segments.src: Millions of owners hold mortgages with rates far below today's levels.
segments.tr: Des millions de propriétaires détiennent des prêts hypothécaires dont les taux sont bien inférieurs aux niveaux actuels.

segments.src: Selling and buying again would mean swapping a cheap loan for an expensive one, so many choose to stay where they are.
segments.tr: Vendre et racheter signifierait échanger un prêt bon marché contre un prêt cher, de sorte que beaucoup choisissent de rester où ils sont.

segments.src: This is often called the lock-in effect.
segments.tr: C'est ce qu'on appelle souvent l'effet de blocage.

segments.src: It keeps the supply of existing homes for sale unusually low.
segments.tr: Il maintient l'offre de logements existants à vendre à un niveau anormalement bas.

segments.src: The result is a split market:
segments.tr: Il en résulte un marché divisé :

segments.src: - **Fewer listings** support prices in many areas, even though demand is weak.
segments.tr: - **Un nombre d'annonces plus faible** soutient les prix dans de nombreuses régions, malgré une demande faible.

segments.src: - **Longer time on market** for homes that are priced too high, which pushes some sellers to cut prices or offer concessions.
segments.tr: - **Des délais de vente plus longs** pour les logements dont le prix est trop élevé, ce qui pousse certains vendeurs à baisser les prix ou à faire des concessions.

segments.src: - **Seller-paid incentives**, such as rate buydowns or help with closing costs, have become more common as a way to bring monthly payments down for buyers.
segments.tr: - **Des incitations financées par le vendeur**, telles que la réduction temporaire des taux ou la prise en charge des frais de clôture, sont devenues plus courantes pour alléger les mensualités des acheteurs.

segments.src: Sellers who must move for work, family or financial reasons face the toughest trade-offs.
segments.tr: Les vendeurs qui doivent déménager pour des raisons professionnelles, familiales ou financières font face aux compromis les plus difficiles.

segments.src: They may need to price realistically and be flexible on terms.
segments.tr: Ils devront peut-être fixer des prix réalistes et faire preuve de flexibilité sur les conditions.

segments.src: ## Pressure on builders
segments.tr: ## La pression sur les promoteurs

segments.src: Homebuilders feel the squeeze from both sides.
segments.tr: Les promoteurs immobiliers subissent la pression des deux côtés.

segments.src: Higher mortgage rates cool demand.
segments.tr: Des taux hypothécaires plus élevés refroidissent la demande.

segments.src: Meanwhile, builders face their own borrowing costs for land and construction loans, along with the price of labor and materials.
segments.tr: Parallèlement, les promoteurs font face à leurs propres coûts d'emprunt pour les prêts fonciers et de construction, ainsi qu'au coût de la main-d'œuvre et des matériaux.

segments.src: Because existing-home inventory is so tight, new construction has taken a larger share of the sales that do happen.
segments.tr: Le stock de logements existants étant très restreint, la construction neuve s'est accaparée une part plus importante des ventes qui ont lieu.

segments.src: Many builders have responded by:
segments.tr: De nombreux promoteurs ont réagi en :

segments.src: - offering mortgage rate buydowns or closing-cost credits,
segments.tr: - proposant des baisses de taux hypothécaires ou des crédits sur les frais de clôture,

segments.src: - building smaller, more affordable floor plans,
segments.tr: - construisant des plans d'aménagement plus petits et plus abordables,

segments.src: - slowing land purchases and new starts when demand softens.
segments.tr: - ralentissant les achats de terrains et les nouveaux chantiers lorsque la demande faiblit.

segments.src: If high rates persist, slower construction could limit future supply and keep housing costs elevated over the longer term, a trade-off that housing economists continue to debate.
segments.tr: Si des taux élevés persistent, un ralentissement de la construction pourrait limiter l'offre future et maintenir les coûts du logement à un niveau élevé à long terme, un compromis que les économistes de l'immobilier continuent de débattre.

segments.src: ## What it means for the broader economy
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour l'économie dans son ensemble

segments.src: Housing touches a large share of economic activity, from construction jobs and furniture sales to moving services and banking.
segments.tr: Le logement touche une grande part de l'activité économique, des emplois dans la construction et des ventes de meubles aux services de déménagement et aux banques.

segments.src: When transactions slow, those sectors feel it.
segments.tr: Lorsque les transactions ralentissent, ces secteurs le ressentent.

segments.src: Higher yields also raise borrowing costs for businesses and the government itself, which is one reason policymakers watch long-term rates closely.
segments.tr: Des rendements plus élevés augmentent également les coûts d'emprunt pour les entreprises et pour le gouvernement lui-même, ce qui explique pourquoi les décideurs politiques surveillent de près les taux à long terme.

segments.src: At the same time, higher yields are not all bad news.
segments.tr: En même temps, des rendements plus élevés ne sont pas entièrement de mauvaise augure.

segments.src: Savers can earn more on Treasury securities, certificates of deposit and high-yield savings accounts.
segments.tr: Les épargnants peuvent gagner davantage sur les titres du Trésor, les certificats de dépôt et les comptes d'épargne à haut rendement.

segments.src: Those returns help offset higher costs for some households, particularly retirees who rely on interest income.
segments.tr: Ces rendements contribuent à compenser l'augmentation des coûts pour certains ménages, en particulier les retraités qui dépendent des revenus d'intérêts.

segments.src: ## Practical steps to consider
segments.tr: ## Mesures pratiques à envisager

segments.src: Every situation is different, but these general ideas come up often in consumer guidance:
segments.tr: Chaque situation est différente, mais ces idées générales reviennent souvent dans les conseils aux consommateurs :

segments.src: 1. **Check your credit.** A higher score can qualify you for a better rate. Review your credit reports for errors before applying.
segments.tr: 1. **Vérifiez votre crédit.** Un score plus élevé peut vous permettre d'obtenir un meilleur taux. Examinez vos rapports de crédit à la recherche d'erreurs avant de faire une demande.

segments.src: 2. **Compare lenders.** Quotes can differ meaningfully. Ask for a Loan Estimate from several lenders and compare both rates and fees.
segments.tr: 2. **Comparez les prêteurs.** Les offres peuvent différer sensiblement. Demandez une estimation de prêt à plusieurs prêteurs et comparez à la fois les taux et les frais.

segments.src: 3. **Understand the total cost.** Look at points, closing costs and insurance, not just the interest rate.
segments.tr: 3. **Comprenez le coût total.** Examinez les points, les frais de clôture et l'assurance, et pas seulement le taux d'intérêt.

segments.src: 4. **Ask about refinancing later.** If you buy now and rates fall, you may be able to refinance, but there is no guarantee. Check for fees and make sure the savings justify the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **Renseignez-vous sur un futur refinancement.** Si vous achetez maintenant et que les taux baissent, vous pourrez peut-être vous refinancer, mais rien n'est garanti. Vérifiez les frais et assurez-vous que les économies justifient le coût.

segments.src: 5. **Keep a cushion.** Make sure you can afford the payment and still have emergency savings.
segments.tr: 5. **Conservez une réserve.** Assurez-vous de pouvoir payer la mensualité tout en conservant une épargne de secours.

segments.src: 6. **Talk to a professional.** A housing counselor, mortgage officer or financial adviser can help you weigh your options. HUD-approved housing counselors offer free or low-cost guidance in the United States.
segments.tr: 6. **Parlez à un professionnel.** Un conseiller en logement, un agent de prêt hypothécaire ou un conseiller financier peut vous aider à peser vos options. Les conseillers en logement agréés par le HUD proposent des conseils gratuits ou à faible coût aux États-Unis.

segments.src: ## What to watch this fall
segments.tr: ## À surveiller cet automne

segments.src: - **Inflation reports.** Cooler readings could ease pressure on yields. Hotter ones could add to it.
segments.tr: - **Les rapports sur l'inflation.** Des chiffres plus bas pourraient atténuer la pression sur les rendements. Des chiffres plus élevés pourraient l'accentuer.

segments.src: - **Federal Reserve meetings.** Statements about the future path of rates often move the bond market.
segments.tr: - **Les réunions de la Réserve fédérale.** Les déclarations concernant l'orientation future des taux font souvent bouger le marché obligataire.

segments.src: - **Treasury auctions and deficit news.** Demand for government debt influences yields.
segments.tr: - **Les adjudications du Trésor et l'actualité du déficit.** La demande pour la dette publique influence les rendements.

segments.src: - **Existing-home sales and builder sentiment.** These show whether buyers are adapting or pulling back.
segments.tr: - **Les ventes de logements existants et le moral des promoteurs.** Ceux-ci montrent si les acheteurs s'adaptent ou se retirent.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: A 10-year Treasury yield above 5% is a reminder that mortgage rates are shaped by forces well beyond any one lender or homebuyer.
segments.tr: Un rendement du Trésor à 10 ans supérieur à 5 % rappelle que les taux hypothécaires sont façonnés par des forces qui échappent largement à tout prêteur ou acheteur individuel.

segments.src: For now, elevated yields are keeping borrowing costs high, holding many owners in place and testing builders' margins.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, des rendements élevés maintiennent les coûts d'emprunt à un niveau élevé, retiennent de nombreux propriétaires chez eux et mettent à l'épreuve les marges des promoteurs.

segments.src: No one can say for sure when conditions will change, and forecasts have a mixed record.
segments.tr: Personne ne peut dire avec certitude quand la situation changera, et les prévisions ont des bilans mitigés.

segments.src: The most useful approach for most households is to focus on what they can control: their budget, their credit and their time horizon.
segments.tr: L'approche la plus utile pour la plupart des ménages consiste à se concentrer sur ce qu'ils peuvent contrôler : leur budget, leur crédit et leur horizon temporel.

segments.tr: Quando o rendimento de referência do Tesouro de 10 anos sobe acima de 5%, os efeitos raramente ficam restritos ao mercado de títulos.

segments.src: They show up in monthly mortgage payments, in the listings that sit unsold, and in the spreadsheets of homebuilders deciding whether to break ground.
segments.tr: Eles aparecem nos pagamentos mensais de hipotecas, nos anúncios de imóveis que continuam sem vender e nas planilhas de construtoras que decidem se devem iniciar uma obra.

segments.src: With the yield hovering near levels not seen in roughly two decades, home loan rates are staying stubbornly elevated.
segments.tr: Com o rendimento oscilando perto de patamares não vistos em cerca de duas décadas, as taxas de empréstimo imobiliário continuam persistentemente elevadas.

segments.src: ## Why the 10-year yield matters for mortgages
segments.tr: ## Por que o rendimento de 10 anos importa para as hipotecas

segments.src: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate does not move in lockstep with the Federal Reserve's policy rate.
segments.tr: A taxa de hipoteca fixa de 30 anos não se move em sincronia com a taxa básica de juros do Federal Reserve.

segments.src: It tends to track the 10-year Treasury yield instead.
segments.tr: Ela tende a acompanhar o rendimento do Tesouro de 10 anos.

segments.src: Investors who buy mortgage-backed securities compare the return on those bonds with the safe return on government debt.
segments.tr: Investidores que compram títulos respaldados por hipotecas comparam o retorno desses títulos com o retorno seguro da dívida pública.

segments.src: Lenders then price home loans to deliver a return above that benchmark.
segments.tr: Os credores então precificam os empréstimos imobiliários para entregar um retorno acima dessa referência.

segments.src: The gap between the two is called the mortgage spread.
segments.tr: A diferença entre os dois é chamada de spread de hipoteca.

segments.src: In calmer periods it has historically averaged somewhere around 1.7 percentage points.
segments.tr: Em períodos mais calmos, historicamente tem ficado em média em torno de 1,7 ponto percentual.

segments.src: In recent years it has often been wider, because of interest-rate volatility and uncertainty about how quickly borrowers will refinance or move.
segments.tr: Nos últimos anos, tem sido frequentemente maior devido à volatilidade das taxas de juros e à incerteza sobre a rapidez com que os mutuários vão refinanciar ou se mudar.

segments.src: A higher Treasury yield plus a wider spread means a higher mortgage rate, even if the central bank holds its policy rate steady.
segments.tr: Um rendimento do Tesouro mais alto somado a um spread mais amplo significa uma taxa de hipoteca mais alta, mesmo que o banco central mantenha sua taxa básica estável.

segments.tr: ## O que está empurrando os rendimentos para cima

segments.tr: Várias forças tendem a elevar os rendimentos de longo prazo ao mesmo tempo:

segments.src: - **Heavy government borrowing.** Large federal deficits mean more Treasury debt for investors to absorb, which can push up the yield needed to attract buyers.
segments.tr: - **Forte endividamento do governo.** Grandes déficits federais significam mais dívida do Tesouro para os investidores absorverem, o que pode empurrar para cima o rendimento necessário para atrair compradores.

segments.src: - **Sticky inflation.** If price growth cools more slowly than expected, investors demand more compensation for holding long-term bonds.
segments.tr: - **Inflação persistente.** Se o crescimento dos preços esfriar mais devagar do que o esperado, os investidores exigem mais compensação por manter títulos de longo prazo.

segments.src: - **A "higher for longer" policy outlook.** When markets expect the Fed to keep rates elevated, longer-term yields adjust upward.
segments.tr: - **Perspectiva de política de "juros mais altos por mais tempo".** Quando os mercados esperam que o Fed mantenha as taxas elevadas, os rendimentos de longo prazo se ajustam para cima.

segments.src: - **A larger term premium.** Investors may ask for extra yield to cover the risk of holding long-dated debt amid economic and political uncertainty.
segments.tr: - **Prêmio de prazo maior.** Os investidores podem pedir um rendimento extra para cobrir o risco de manter dívidas de longo prazo em meio à incerteza econômica e política.

segments.src: No single factor explains the move, and analysts disagree about how much weight each one deserves.

segments.tr: Enquanto isso, as construtoras enfrentam seus próprios custos de empréstimo para terrenos e financiamento de construção, juntamente com o preço de mão de obra e materiais.

segments.src: Because existing-home inventory is so tight, new construction has taken a larger share of the sales that do happen.
segments.tr: Como o estoque de casas existentes é muito restrito, a nova construção assumiu uma fatia maior das vendas que realmente acontecem.

segments.src: Many builders have responded by:
segments.tr: Muitas construtoras responderam:

segments.src: - offering mortgage rate buydowns or closing-cost credits,
segments.tr: - oferecendo reduções nas taxas de hipoteca ou créditos para custos de fechamento,

segments.src: - building smaller, more affordable floor plans,
segments.tr: - construindo plantas menores e mais acessíveis,

segments.src: - slowing land purchases and new starts when demand softens.
segments.tr: - desacelerando a compra de terrenos e novos inícios de obras quando a demanda enfraquece.

segments.src: If high rates persist, slower construction could limit future supply and keep housing costs elevated over the longer term, a trade-off that housing economists continue to debate.
segments.tr: Se as taxas altas persistirem, uma construção mais lenta pode limitar a oferta futura e manter os custos de habitação elevados a longo prazo, um dilema que os economistas imobiliários continuam a debater.

segments.src: ## What it means for the broader economy
segments.tr: ## O que isso significa para a economia em geral

segments.src: Housing touches a large share of economic activity, from construction jobs and furniture sales to moving services and banking.

segments.src: When transactions slow, those sectors feel it.
segments.tr: Quando as transações desaceleram, esses setores sentem o impacto.

segments.src: Higher yields also raise borrowing costs for businesses and the government itself, which is one reason policymakers watch long-term rates closely.

segments.src: Savers can earn more on Treasury securities, certificates of deposit and high-yield savings accounts.

segments.src: Those returns help offset higher costs for some households, particularly retirees who rely on interest income.

segments.src: ## Practical steps to consider

segments.src: Every situation is different, but these general ideas come up often in consumer guidance:

segments.src: 1. **Check your credit.** A higher score can qualify you for a better rate. Review your credit reports for errors before applying.

segments.src: 2. **Compare lenders.** Quotes can differ meaningfully. Ask for a Loan Estimate from several lenders and compare both rates and fees.

segments.src: 3. **Understand the total cost.** Look at points, closing costs and insurance, not just the interest rate.

segments.src: 4. **Ask about refinancing later.** If you buy now and rates fall, you may be able to refinance, but there is no guarantee. Check for fees and make sure the savings justify the cost.

segments.tr: 5. **Mantenha uma reserva.** Certifique-se de poder pagar a prestação e ainda ter poupança para emergências.

segments.src: The most useful approach for most households is to focus on what they can control: their budget, their credit and their time horizon.

segments.src: - **Heavy government borrowing.** Large federal deficits mean more Treasury debt for investors to absorb, which can push up the yield needed to attract buyers.
segments.tr: - **巨額の政府借入。** 連邦財政赤字の拡大は、投資家が吸収すべき国債の増加を意味し、買い手を惹きつけるために必要な利回りを押し上げる可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Sticky inflation.** If price growth cools more slowly than expected, investors demand more compensation for holding long-term bonds.
segments.tr: - **根強いインフレ。** 物価上昇の鈍化が予想よりも遅い場合、投資家は長期債を保有するためにさらなる見返りを求めます。

segments.src: - **A "higher for longer" policy outlook.** When markets expect the Fed to keep rates elevated, longer-term yields adjust upward.
segments.tr: - **「高金利の長期化」という政策見通し。** 市場がFRBによる高金利の維持を予想すると、長期金利は上方に調整されます。

segments.src: - **A larger term premium.** Investors may ask for extra yield to cover the risk of holding long-dated debt amid economic and political uncertainty.
segments.tr: - **より大きなタームプレミアム。** 投資家は、経済的および政治的不確実性の中で長期債を保有するリスクをカバーするために、追加の利回りを求める場合があります。

segments.src: No single factor explains the move, and analysts disagree about how much weight each one deserves.
segments.tr: 単一の要因だけでこの動きを説明することはできず、アナリストの間でもそれぞれの要因がどれだけの比重を持つべきかについては意見が分かれています。

segments.src: ## The squeeze on buyers
segments.tr: ## 購入者へのプレッシャー

segments.src: For buyers, the arithmetic is unforgiving.
segments.tr: 購入者にとって、計算は容赦ありません。

segments.src: Consider a $400,000 loan on a 30-year fixed mortgage, counting principal and interest only:
segments.tr: 元本と利息のみを計算に入れた、30年固定住宅ローンでの400,000ドルのローンを考えてみます：

segments.src: | Mortgage rate | Approx. monthly payment |
segments.tr: | 住宅ローン金利 | 想定月額返済額 |

segments.src: Going from 3% to 7% adds close to $1,000 a month on the same loan.
segments.tr: 3%から7%に移行すると、同じローンで月額約1,000ドル増加します。

segments.src: Taxes, insurance and maintenance come on top of that.
segments.tr: それに加えて税金、保険、メンテナンス費用がかかります。

segments.src: Many households that qualified comfortably a few years ago now find the numbers don't work, or they shop for a smaller home, a different neighborhood or a longer commute.
segments.tr: 数年前には余裕で資格を満たしていた多くの世帯が、現在では数字が合わないことに気づくか、あるいはより小さな家、異なる近隣地域、またはより長い通勤時間を探しています。

segments.src: Common responses among buyers include:
segments.tr: 購入者の間で一般的な対応には以下が含まれます：

segments.src: - **Rethinking the budget.** Some buyers now plan around the monthly payment instead of the headline price.
segments.tr: - **予算の再考。** 一部の購入者は現在、見出しの価格ではなく月々の支払いに合わせて計画を立てています。

segments.src: - **Larger down payments.** Putting more money down reduces the loan amount and the interest paid over time.
segments.tr: - **多額の頭金。** より多くの頭金を支払うことで、ローン金額と時間の経過とともに支払われる利息が削減されます。

segments.src: - **Adjustable-rate mortgages.** These offer lower initial rates but carry the risk of higher payments later. Borrowers should read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - **変動金利型住宅ローン。** これらは初期金利は低いですが、後で支払額が増加するリスクを伴います。借り手は条件を注意深く読む必要があります。

segments.src: - **Waiting.** Some renters are staying put until rates ease, though waiting has its own costs if prices or rents keep rising.
segments.tr: - **待つこと。** 一部の賃借人は金利が下がるまでそのままでいますが、価格や家賃が上昇し続ける場合、待つこと自体にコストがかかります。

segments.src: ## The "lock-in effect" and sellers
segments.tr: ## 「ロックイン効果」と売主

segments.src: Rates also affect the people who already own homes.
segments.tr: 金利はすでに家を所有している人々にも影響を与えます。

segments.src: Millions of owners hold mortgages with rates far below today's levels.
segments.tr: 何百万人もの所有者が、今日の水準をはるかに下回る金利の住宅ローンを組んでいます。

segments.src: Selling and buying again would mean swapping a cheap loan for an expensive one, so many choose to stay where they are.
segments.tr: 売却して再び購入することは、安いローンを高いローンに切り替えることを意味するため、多くの人が現在留まることを選択しています。

segments.src: This is often called the lock-in effect.
segments.tr: これはしばしばロックイン効果と呼ばれます。

segments.src: It keeps the supply of existing homes for sale unusually low.
segments.tr: これにより、売りに出されている既存の住宅の供給が異常に少なくなっています。

segments.src: The result is a split market:
segments.tr: その結果は分断された市場です：

segments.src: - **Fewer listings** support prices in many areas, even though demand is weak.
segments.tr: - **物件数の減少**は、需要が弱いにもかかわらず、多くの地域で価格を支えています。

segments.src: - **Longer time on market** for homes that are priced too high, which pushes some sellers to cut prices or offer concessions.
segments.tr: - **価格が高すぎる住宅の市場滞在期間の長期化**は、一部の売主に価格の引き下げや譲歩を促しています。

segments.src: - **Seller-paid incentives**, such as rate buydowns or help with closing costs, have become more common as a way to bring monthly payments down for buyers.
segments.tr: - **売主負担のインセンティブ**（金利の買い取りやクロージングコストの補助など）は、購入者の月々の支払いを減らす方法として一般的になっています。

segments.src: Sellers who must move for work, family or financial reasons face the toughest trade-offs.
segments.tr: 仕事、家族、または財務上の理由で引っ越しを余儀なくされる売主は、最も厳しいトレードオフに直面します。

segments.src: They may need to price realistically and be flexible on terms.
segments.tr: 現実的な価格設定をし、条件に対して柔軟に対応する必要があるかもしれません。

segments.src: ## Pressure on builders
segments.tr: ## ビルダーへの圧力

segments.src: Homebuilders feel the squeeze from both sides.
segments.tr: ハウスビルダーは両側から圧力を感じています。

segments.src: Higher mortgage rates cool demand.
segments.tr: 住宅ローン金利の上昇は需要を冷え込ませます。

segments.src: Meanwhile, builders face their own borrowing costs for land and construction loans, along with the price of labor and materials.
segments.tr: 一方、ビルダーは土地や建設ローンのための独自の借入コストに加え、労働力や材料の価格に直面しています。

segments.src: Because existing-home inventory is so tight, new construction has taken a larger share of the sales that do happen.
segments.tr: 既存住宅の在庫が非常にタイトであるため、新築は実際に発生する売上のより大きなシェアを占めています。

segments.src: Many builders have responded by:
segments.tr: 多くのビルダーは以下の方法で対応しています：

segments.src: - offering mortgage rate buydowns or closing-cost credits,
segments.tr: - 住宅ローン金利の買い取りやクロージングコストのクレジットの提供、

segments.src: - building smaller, more affordable floor plans,
segments.tr: - より小さく手頃な価格の間取りの建築、

segments.src: - slowing land purchases and new starts when demand softens.
segments.tr: - 需要が軟化した際の土地購入や新規着工の減速。

segments.src: If high rates persist, slower construction could limit future supply and keep housing costs elevated over the longer term, a trade-off that housing economists continue to debate.
segments.tr: 高金利が持続した場合、建設の遅延が将来の供給を制限し、長期にわたって住宅コストを高止まりさせる可能性があり、これは住宅エコノミストが議論を続けているトレードオフです。

segments.src: ## What it means for the broader economy
segments.tr: ## 広範な経済にとって何を意味するか

segments.src: Housing touches a large share of economic activity, from construction jobs and furniture sales to moving services and banking.
segments.tr: 住宅は、建設の仕事や家具の販売から引っ越しサービスや銀行業務に至るまで、経済活動の大きなシェアに触れています。

segments.src: When transactions slow, those sectors feel it.
segments.tr: 取引がスローダウンすると、それらのセクターがそれを感じます。

segments.src: Higher yields also raise borrowing costs for businesses and the government itself, which is one reason policymakers watch long-term rates closely.
segments.tr: 利回りの上昇はまた、企業や政府自身の借入コストも上昇させます。これが、政策立案者が長期金利を注意深く監視している理由の1つです。

segments.src: At the same time, higher yields are not all bad news.
segments.tr: 同時に、利回りの上昇がすべて悪いニュースというわけではありません。

segments.src: Savers can earn more on Treasury securities, certificates of deposit and high-yield savings accounts.
segments.tr: 預金者は国債、定期預金、高利回り普通預金でより多くを稼ぐことができます。

segments.src: Those returns help offset higher costs for some households, particularly retirees who rely on interest income.
segments.tr: それらのリターンは、一部の世帯、特に利子収入に頼る退職者にとって、高コストを相殺するのに役立ちます。

segments.src: ## Practical steps to consider
segments.tr: ## 考慮すべき実践的なステップ

segments.src: Every situation is different, but these general ideas come up often in consumer guidance:
segments.tr: すべての状況は異なりますが、これらの一般的なアイデアは消費者向けガイダンスで頻繁に取り上げられます：

segments.src: 1. **Check your credit.** A higher score can qualify you for a better rate. Review your credit reports for errors before applying.
segments.tr: 1. **クレジットを確認する。** スコアが高ければ、より良い金利の資格を得ることができます。申請前にクレジットレポートにエラーがないか確認してください。

segments.src: 2. **Compare lenders.** Quotes can differ meaningfully. Ask for a Loan Estimate from several lenders and compare both rates and fees.
segments.tr: 2. **貸し手を比較する。** 見積もりは意味のある形で異なる場合があります。複数の貸し手からローン見積もり（Loan Estimate）を求め、金利と手数料の両方を比較してください。

segments.src: 3. **Understand the total cost.** Look at points, closing costs and insurance, not just the interest rate.
segments.tr: 3. **総コストを理解する。** 金利だけでなく、ポイント、クロージングコスト、保険に注目してください。

segments.src: 4. **Ask about refinancing later.** If you buy now and rates fall, you may be able to refinance, but there is no guarantee. Check for fees and make sure the savings justify the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **後からの借り換えについて尋ねる。** 今購入して金利が下がった場合、借り換えができる可能性がありますが、保証はありません。手数料を確認し、節約額がコストを正当化することを確認してください。

segments.src: 5. **Keep a cushion.** Make sure you can afford the payment and still have emergency savings.
segments.tr: 5. **クッションを維持する。** 支払いに余裕があり、かつ緊急時の貯蓄がまだあることを確認してください。

segments.src: 6. **Talk to a professional.** A housing counselor, mortgage officer or financial adviser can help you weigh your options. HUD-approved housing counselors offer free or low-cost guidance in the United States.
segments.tr: 6. **専門家に相談する。** 住宅カウンセラー、住宅ローン担当者、またはファイナンシャルアドバイザーがオプションを検討するのを手助けできます。HUD認定の住宅カウンセラーは、米国で無料または低コストのガイダンスを提供しています。

segments.src: ## What to watch this fall
segments.tr: ## この秋に注目すべきこと

segments.src: - **Inflation reports.** Cooler readings could ease pressure on yields. Hotter ones could add to it.
segments.tr: - **インフレレポート。** より低い数値は利回りの圧力を緩和する可能性があります。より高い数値はそれに加わる可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Federal Reserve meetings.** Statements about the future path of rates often move the bond market.
segments.tr: - **連邦準備制度理事会の会合。** 金利の将来の道筋に関する声明は、しばしば債券市場を動かします。

segments.src: - **Treasury auctions and deficit news.** Demand for government debt influences yields.
segments.tr: - **国債入札と財政赤字のニュース。** 政府債務に対する需要は利回りに影響を与えます。

segments.src: - **Existing-home sales and builder sentiment.** These show whether buyers are adapting or pulling back.
segments.tr: - **既存住宅販売とビルダーのセンチメント。** これらは、購入者が適応しているのか、それとも撤退しているのかを示しています。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: A 10-year Treasury yield above 5% is a reminder that mortgage rates are shaped by forces well beyond any one lender or homebuyer.
segments.tr: 5%を超える10年物国債利回りは、住宅ローン金利が単一の貸し手や住宅購入者のはるかに超えた力によって形作られていることを思い出させるものです。

segments.src: For now, elevated yields are keeping borrowing costs high, holding many owners in place and testing builders' margins.
segments.tr: 今のところ、高水準の利回りは借入コストを高止まりさせ、多くの所有者をその場にとどめ、ビルダーのマージンを試しています。

segments.src: No one can say for sure when conditions will change, and forecasts have a mixed record.
segments.tr: 状況がいつ変わるかを確実に言うことは誰にもできず、予測の記録はさまざまです。

segments.src: The most useful approach for most households is to focus on what they can control: their budget, their credit and their time horizon.
segments.tr: ほとんどの世帯にとって最も有用なアプローチは、自分たちがコントロールできること、つまり予算、クレジット、そして時間軸に集中することです。

de.title: Über 5 %: Was eine 19-Jahres-Höchstrendite bei Staatsanleihen für Hypothekenzinsen und den Immobilienmarkt bedeutet

segments.src: When the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield climbs above 5%, the effects rarely stay in the bond market.
segments.tr: Wenn die Rendite der 10-jährigen Benchmark-Staatsanleihe über 5 % steigt, bleiben die Auswirkungen selten auf den Anleihemarkt beschränkt.

segments.src: They show up in monthly mortgage payments, in the listings that sit unsold, and in the spreadsheets of homebuilders deciding whether to break ground.
segments.tr: Sie zeigen sich bei monatlichen Hypothekenzahlungen, bei Immobilienangeboten, die unverkauft bleiben, und in den Kalkulationstabellen von Bauunternehmen, die entscheiden, ob sie mit dem Bau beginnen sollen.

segments.src: With the yield hovering near levels not seen in roughly two decades, home loan rates are staying stubbornly elevated.
segments.tr: Da die Rendite auf einem Niveau verharrt, das seit etwa zwei Jahrzehnten nicht mehr erreicht wurde, bleiben die Bauzinsen hartnäckig hoch.

segments.src: Here is how that is squeezing buyers, sellers and builders heading into the fall.
segments.tr: Hier erfahren Sie, wie dies Käufer, Verkäufer und Bauunternehmen im Hinblick auf den Herbst unter Druck setzt.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not financial, investment or mortgage advice.
segments.tr: *Dieser Artikel dient nur der allgemeinen Information und stellt keine Finanz-, Anlage- oder Hypothekenberatung dar.

segments.src: Rates and market conditions change often, so check current figures with a licensed professional before making decisions.*
segments.tr: Zinsen und Marktbedingungen ändern sich häufig, prüfen Sie daher die aktuellen Zahlen bei einem lizenzierten Fachmann, bevor Sie Entscheidungen treffen.*

segments.src: ## Why the 10-year yield matters for mortgages
segments.tr: ## Warum die 10-jährige Rendite für Hypotheken wichtig ist

segments.src: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate does not move in lockstep with the Federal Reserve's policy rate.
segments.tr: Der Zinssatz für 30-jährige Festhypotheken bewegt sich nicht im Gleichschritt mit dem Leitzins der Federal Reserve.

segments.src: It tends to track the 10-year Treasury yield instead.
segments.tr: Er orientiert sich stattdessen eher an der Rendite 10-jähriger Staatsanleihen.

segments.src: Investors who buy mortgage-backed securities compare the return on those bonds with the safe return on government debt.
segments.tr: Anleger, die hypothekenbesicherte Wertpapiere kaufen, vergleichen die Rendite dieser Anleihen mit der sicheren Rendite von Staatsanleihen.

segments.src: Lenders then price home loans to deliver a return above that benchmark.
segments.tr: Kreditgeber kalkulieren Immobilienkredite dann so, dass sie eine Rendite über diesem Referenzwert erzielen.

segments.src: The gap between the two is called the mortgage spread.
segments.tr: Die Differenz zwischen beiden wird als Hypotheken-Spread bezeichnet.

segments.src: In calmer periods it has historically averaged somewhere around 1.7 percentage points.
segments.tr: In ruhigeren Zeiten lag dieser historisch gesehen bei etwa 1,7 Prozentpunkten.

segments.src: In recent years it has often been wider, because of interest-rate volatility and uncertainty about how quickly borrowers will refinance or move.
segments.tr: In den letzten Jahren war er oft breiter, aufgrund der Volatilität der Zinssätze und der Unsicherheit darüber, wie schnell Kreditnehmer umschulden oder umziehen werden.

segments.src: A higher Treasury yield plus a wider spread means a higher mortgage rate, even if the central bank holds its policy rate steady.
segments.tr: Eine höhere Rendite bei Staatsanleihen plus ein breiterer Spread bedeuten einen höheren Hypothekenzins, selbst wenn die Zentralbank ihren Leitzins stabil hält.

segments.src: ## What is pushing yields up
segments.tr: ## Was die Renditen in die Höhe treibt

segments.src: Several forces tend to lift long-term yields at the same time:
segments.tr: Mehrere Kräfte tendieren dazu, die langfristigen Renditen gleichzeitig anzuheben:

segments.src: - **Heavy government borrowing.** Large federal deficits mean more Treasury debt for investors to absorb, which can push up the yield needed to attract buyers.
segments.tr: - **Hohe staatliche Kreditaufnahme.** Große Bundesdefizite bedeuten mehr Staatsanleihen, die von Anlegern aufgenommen werden müssen, was die Rendite in die Höhe treiben kann, die erforderlich ist, um Käufer anzuziehen.

segments.src: - **Sticky inflation.** If price growth cools more slowly than expected, investors demand more compensation for holding long-term bonds.
segments.tr: - **Hartnäckige Inflation.** Wenn sich das Preiswachstum langsamer abkühlt als erwartet, verlangen Anleger eine höhere Entschädigung für das Halten langfristiger Anleihen.

segments.src: - **A "higher for longer" policy outlook.** When markets expect the Fed to keep rates elevated, longer-term yields adjust upward.
segments.tr: - **Ein "Higher for Longer"-Politikausblick.** Wenn die Märkte erwarten, dass die Fed die Zinsen hoch hält, passen sich die längerfristigen Renditen nach oben an.

segments.src: - **A larger term premium.** Investors may ask for extra yield to cover the risk of holding long-dated debt amid economic and political uncertainty.
segments.tr: - **Eine größere Laufzeitprämie.** Anleger fordern möglicherweise eine zusätzliche Rendite, um das Risiko des Haltens langfristiger Schulden inmitten wirtschaftlicher und politischer Unsicherheit abzudecken.

segments.src: No single factor explains the move, and analysts disagree about how much weight each one deserves.
segments.tr: Kein einzelner Faktor erklärt die Bewegung, und Analysten sind sich uneinig darüber, wie viel Gewicht jeder einzelne verdient.

segments.src: ## The squeeze on buyers
segments.tr: ## Der Druck auf Käufer

segments.src: For buyers, the arithmetic is unforgiving.
segments.tr: Für Käufer ist die Rechnung unerbittlich.

segments.src: Consider a $400,000 loan on a 30-year fixed mortgage, counting principal and interest only:
segments.tr: Betrachten wir einen Kredit über $400,000 bei einer 30-jährigen Festhypothek, nur unter Berücksichtigung von Tilgung und Zinsen:

segments.src: | Mortgage rate | Approx. monthly payment |
segments.tr: | Hypothekenzins | Ca. monatliche Zahlung |

segments.src: Going from 3% to 7% adds close to $1,000 a month on the same loan.
segments.tr: Der Anstieg von 3 % auf 7 % bedeutet bei demselben Kredit fast $1,000 mehr pro Monat.

segments.src: Taxes, insurance and maintenance come on top of that.
segments.tr: Steuern, Versicherungen und Instandhaltung kommen noch hinzu.

segments.src: Many households that qualified comfortably a few years ago now find the numbers don't work, or they shop for a smaller home, a different neighborhood or a longer commute.
segments.tr: Viele Haushalte, die sich vor ein paar Jahren noch problemlos qualifizierten, stellen jetzt fest, dass die Zahlen nicht aufgehen, oder sie suchen nach einem kleineren Haus, einer anderen Nachbarschaft oder einem längeren Arbeitsweg.

segments.src: Common responses among buyers include:
segments.tr: Zu den häufigen Reaktionen unter Käufern gehören:

segments.src: - **Rethinking the budget.** Some buyers now plan around the monthly payment instead of the headline price.
segments.tr: - **Überdenken des Budgets.** Einige Käufer planen jetzt auf Basis der monatlichen Zahlung statt des angegebenen Preises.

segments.src: - **Larger down payments.** Putting more money down reduces the loan amount and the interest paid over time.
segments.tr: - **Höhere Anzahlungen.** Eine höhere Anzahlung reduziert die Kreditsumme und die im Laufe der Zeit gezahlten Zinsen.

segments.src: - **Adjustable-rate mortgages.** These offer lower initial rates but carry the risk of higher payments later. Borrowers should read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - **Hypotheken mit variablem Zinssatz.** Diese bieten niedrigere Anfangszinsen, bergen aber das Risiko späterer höherer Zahlungen. Kreditnehmer sollten die Bedingungen sorgfältig lesen.

segments.src: - **Waiting.** Some renters are staying put until rates ease, though waiting has its own costs if prices or rents keep rising.
segments.tr: - **Warten.** Einige Mieter bleiben, bis die Zinsen sinken, obwohl das Warten seine eigenen Kosten hat, wenn Preise oder Mieten weiter steigen.

segments.src: ## The "lock-in effect" and sellers
segments.tr: ## Der "Lock-in-Effekt" und Verkäufer

segments.src: Rates also affect the people who already own homes.
segments.tr: Die Zinsen betreffen auch Menschen, die bereits ein Haus besitzen.

segments.src: Millions of owners hold mortgages with rates far below today's levels.
segments.tr: Millionen von Eigentümern haben Hypotheken mit Zinssätzen, die weit unter dem heutigen Niveau liegen.

segments.src: Selling and buying again would mean swapping a cheap loan for an expensive one, so many choose to stay where they are.
segments.tr: Verkaufen und erneut kaufen würde bedeuten, einen günstigen Kredit gegen einen teuren einzutauschen, daher entscheiden sich viele, dort zu bleiben, wo sie sind.

segments.src: This is often called the lock-in effect.
segments.tr: Dies wird oft als Lock-in-Effekt bezeichnet.

segments.src: It keeps the supply of existing homes for sale unusually low.
segments.tr: Er hält das Angebot an bestehenden Häusern zum Verkauf ungewöhnlich niedrig.

segments.src: The result is a split market:
segments.tr: Das Ergebnis ist ein gespaltener Markt:

segments.src: - **Fewer listings** support prices in many areas, even though demand is weak.
segments.tr: - **Weniger Angebote** stützen die Preise in vielen Gebieten, obwohl die Nachfrage schwach ist.

segments.src: - **Longer time on market** for homes that are priced too high, which pushes some sellers to cut prices or offer concessions.
segments.tr: - **Längere Zeit auf dem Markt** für Häuser, die zu hoch bewertet sind, was einige Verkäufer dazu zwingt, die Preise zu senken oder Zugeständnisse zu machen.

segments.src: - **Seller-paid incentives**, such as rate buydowns or help with closing costs, have become more common as a way to bring monthly payments down for buyers.
segments.tr: - **Vom Verkäufer gezahlte Anreize**, wie Zinsvergünstigungen oder Hilfe bei den Abschlusskosten, sind häufiger geworden, um die monatlichen Zahlungen für Käufer zu senken.

segments.src: Sellers who must move for work, family or financial reasons face the toughest trade-offs.
segments.tr: Verkäufer, die aus beruflichen, familiären oder finanziellen Gründen umziehen müssen, stehen vor den schwierigsten Kompromissen.

segments.src: They may need to price realistically and be flexible on terms.
segments.tr: Sie müssen möglicherweise realistisch bepreisen und bei den Bedingungen flexibel sein.

segments.src: ## Pressure on builders
segments.tr: ## Druck auf Bauunternehmen

segments.src: Homebuilders feel the squeeze from both sides.
segments.tr: Bauunternehmen spüren den Druck von beiden Seiten.

segments.src: Higher mortgage rates cool demand.
segments.tr: Höhere Hypothekenzinsen kühlen die Nachfrage ab.

segments.src: Meanwhile, builders face their own borrowing costs for land and construction loans, along with the price of labor and materials.
segments.tr: Unterdessen sehen sich Bauunternehmen mit ihren eigenen Kreditkosten für Land- und Baukredite sowie den Preisen für Arbeit und Material konfrontiert.

segments.src: Because existing-home inventory is so tight, new construction has taken a larger share of the sales that do happen.
segments.tr: Da der Bestand an bestehenden Häusern so knapp ist, haben Neubauten einen größeren Anteil an den tatsächlich stattfindenden Verkäufen eingenommen.

segments.src: Many builders have responded by:
segments.tr: Viele Bauunternehmen haben darauf reagiert, indem sie:

segments.src: - offering mortgage rate buydowns or closing-cost credits,
segments.tr: - Hypothekenzinsvergünstigungen oder Gutschriften für Abschlusskosten anbieten,

segments.src: - building smaller, more affordable floor plans,
segments.tr: - kleinere, erschwinglichere Grundrisse bauen,

segments.src: - slowing land purchases and new starts when demand softens.
segments.tr: - Grundstückskäufe und neue Baubeginne verlangsamen, wenn die Nachfrage nachlässt.

segments.src: If high rates persist, slower construction could limit future supply and keep housing costs elevated over the longer term, a trade-off that housing economists continue to debate.
segments.tr: Wenn hohe Zinsen anhalten, könnte ein langsameres Bauwachstum das zukünftige Angebot begrenzen und die Wohnkosten langfristig hoch halten, ein Kompromiss, über den Immobilienökonomen weiterhin debattieren.

segments.src: ## What it means for the broader economy
segments.tr: ## Was es für die breitere Wirtschaft bedeutet

segments.src: Housing touches a large share of economic activity, from construction jobs and furniture sales to moving services and banking.
segments.tr: Wohnungsbau betrifft einen großen Teil der wirtschaftlichen Aktivität, von Baujobs und Möbelverkäufen bis hin zu Umzugsdiensten und Bankwesen.

segments.src: When transactions slow, those sectors feel it.
segments.tr: Wenn Transaktionen verlangsamt werden, spüren diese Sektoren das.

segments.src: Higher yields also raise borrowing costs for businesses and the government itself, which is one reason policymakers watch long-term rates closely.
segments.tr: Höhere Renditen erhöhen auch die Kreditkosten für Unternehmen und den Staat selbst, was ein Grund dafür ist, dass politische Entscheidungsträger die langfristigen Zinsen genau beobachten.

segments.src: At the same time, higher yields are not all bad news.
segments.tr: Gleichzeitig sind höhere Renditen nicht nur schlechte Nachrichten.

segments.src: Savers can earn more on Treasury securities, certificates of deposit and high-yield savings accounts.
segments.tr: Sparer können mehr mit Staatsanleihen, Einlagenzertifikaten und hochverzinslichen Sparkonten verdienen.

segments.src: Those returns help offset higher costs for some households, particularly retirees who rely on interest income.
segments.tr: Diese Erträge helfen, die höheren Kosten für einige Haushalte auszugleichen, insbesondere für Rentner, die auf Zinseinkommen angewiesen sind.

segments.src: ## Practical steps to consider
segments.tr: ## Praktische Schritte zur Überlegung

segments.src: Every situation is different, but these general ideas come up often in consumer guidance:
segments.tr: Jede Situation ist anders, aber diese allgemeinen Ideen tauchen in der Verbraucherberatung häufig auf:

segments.src: 1. **Check your credit.** A higher score can qualify you for a better rate. Review your credit reports for errors before applying.
segments.tr: 1. **Überprüfen Sie Ihre Kreditwürdigkeit.** Ein höherer Score kann Sie für einen besseren Zinssatz qualifizieren. Überprüfen Sie Ihre Kreditauskünfte vor der Beantragung auf Fehler.

segments.src: 2. **Compare lenders.** Quotes can differ meaningfully. Ask for a Loan Estimate from several lenders and compare both rates and fees.
segments.tr: 2. **Vergleichen Sie Kreditgeber.** Angebote können sich deutlich unterscheiden. Fragen Sie bei mehreren Kreditgebern nach einem Kreditangebot (Loan Estimate) und vergleichen Sie sowohl Zinsen als auch Gebühren.

segments.src: 3. **Understand the total cost.** Look at points, closing costs and insurance, not just the interest rate.
segments.tr: 3. **Verstehen Sie die Gesamtkosten.** Achten Sie auf Punkte, Abschlusskosten und Versicherungen, nicht nur auf den Zinssatz.

segments.src: 4. **Ask about refinancing later.** If you buy now and rates fall, you may be able to refinance, but there is no guarantee. Check for fees and make sure the savings justify the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **Fragen Sie nach späterer Umschuldung.** Wenn Sie jetzt kaufen und die Zinsen fallen, können Sie möglicherweise umschulden, aber es gibt keine Garantie. Prüfen Sie die Gebühren und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Einsparungen die Kosten rechtfertigen.

segments.src: 5. **Keep a cushion.** Make sure you can afford the payment and still have emergency savings.
segments.tr: 5. **Behalten Sie ein Polster.** Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie sich die Zahlung leisten können und immer noch Notfallersparnisse haben.

segments.src: 6. **Talk to a professional.** A housing counselor, mortgage officer or financial adviser can help you weigh your options. HUD-approved housing counselors offer free or low-cost guidance in the United States.
segments.tr: 6. **Sprechen Sie mit einem Fachmann.** Ein Wohnungsbauberater, Hypothekenberater oder Finanzberater kann Ihnen helfen, Ihre Optionen abzuwägen. HUD-zugelassene Wohnungsbauberater bieten in den Vereinigten Staaten kostenlose oder kostengünstige Beratung an.

segments.src: ## What to watch this fall
segments.tr: ## Was diesen Herbst zu beobachten ist

segments.src: - **Inflation reports.** Cooler readings could ease pressure on yields. Hotter ones could add to it.
segments.tr: - **Inflationsberichte.** Kühlere Werte könnten den Druck auf die Renditen verringern. Heißere könnten ihn erhöhen.

segments.src: - **Federal Reserve meetings.** Statements about the future path of rates often move the bond market.
segments.tr: - **Sitzungen der Federal Reserve.** Aussagen über den zukünftigen Zinspfad bewegen oft den Anleihemarkt.

segments.src: - **Treasury auctions and deficit news.** Demand for government debt influences yields.
segments.tr: - **Auktionen von Staatsanleihen und Defizitnachrichten.** Die Nachfrage nach Staatsschulden beeinflusst die Renditen.

segments.src: - **Existing-home sales and builder sentiment.** These show whether buyers are adapting or pulling back.
segments.tr: - **Verkäufe bestehender Häuser und Stimmung der Bauunternehmen.** Diese zeigen, ob sich Käufer anpassen oder zurückziehen.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: A 10-year Treasury yield above 5% is a reminder that mortgage rates are shaped by forces well beyond any one lender or homebuyer.
segments.tr: Eine Rendite von über 5 % bei 10-jährigen Staatsanleihen erinnert daran, dass Hypothekenzinsen von Kräften geprägt werden, die weit über jeden einzelnen Kreditgeber oder Hauskäufer hinausgehen.

segments.src: For now, elevated yields are keeping borrowing costs high, holding many owners in place and testing builders' margins.
segments.tr: Derzeit halten erhöhte Renditen die Kreditkosten hoch, halten viele Eigentümer an ihrem Platz und testen die Margen der Bauunternehmen.

segments.src: No one can say for sure when conditions will change, and forecasts have a mixed record.
segments.tr: Niemand kann mit Sicherheit sagen, wann sich die Bedingungen ändern werden, und Prognosen haben eine gemischte Erfolgsbilanz.

segments.src: The most useful approach for most households is to focus on what they can control: their budget, their credit and their time horizon.
segments.tr: Der nützlichste Ansatz für die meisten Haushalte ist es, sich auf das zu konzentrieren, was sie kontrollieren können: ihr Budget, ihre Kreditwürdigkeit und ihren Zeithorizont.

vi.title: Trên 5%: Lợi suất Trái phiếu Chính phủ kỳ hạn 19 năm ở mức cao nhất có ý nghĩa gì đối với lãi suất thế chấp và thị trường nhà ở

segments.src: When the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield climbs above 5%, the effects rarely stay in the bond market.
segments.tr: Khi lợi suất trái phiếu chính phủ kỳ hạn 10 năm chuẩn tăng vượt mức 5%, các tác động hiếm khi chỉ dừng lại ở thị trường trái phiếu.

segments.src: They show up in monthly mortgage payments, in the listings that sit unsold, and in the spreadsheets of homebuilders deciding whether to break ground.
segments.tr: Chúng xuất hiện trong các khoản thanh toán thế chấp hàng tháng, trong các danh sách nhà bán mãi không được, và trong bảng tính của các nhà xây dựng nhà ở đang quyết định có nên khởi công hay không.

segments.src: With the yield hovering near levels not seen in roughly two decades, home loan rates are staying stubbornly elevated.
segments.tr: Với mức lợi suất dao động gần các mức chưa từng thấy trong khoảng hai thập kỷ, lãi suất cho vay mua nhà vẫn duy trì ở mức cao một cách ngoan cố.

segments.src: Here is how that is squeezing buyers, sellers and builders heading into the fall.
segments.tr: Dưới đây là cách điều đó đang gây áp lực lên người mua, người bán và nhà xây dựng bước vào mùa thu.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not financial, investment or mortgage advice.
segments.tr: *Bài viết này chỉ mang tính chất thông tin chung và không phải là lời khuyên tài chính, đầu tư hay thế chấp.

segments.src: Rates and market conditions change often, so check current figures with a licensed professional before making decisions.*
segments.tr: Lãi suất và điều kiện thị trường thay đổi thường xuyên, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra các số liệu hiện tại với chuyên gia được cấp phép trước khi đưa ra quyết định.*

segments.src: ## Why the 10-year yield matters for mortgages
segments.tr: ## Tại sao lợi suất kỳ hạn 10 năm lại quan trọng đối với các khoản thế chấp

segments.src: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate does not move in lockstep with the Federal Reserve's policy rate.
segments.tr: Lãi suất thế chấp cố định 30 năm không di chuyển đồng bộ với lãi suất chính sách của Cục Dự trữ Liên bang.

segments.src: It tends to track the 10-year Treasury yield instead.
segments.tr: Thay vào đó, nó có xu hướng bám theo lợi suất trái phiếu chính phủ kỳ hạn 10 năm.

segments.src: Investors who buy mortgage-backed securities compare the return on those bonds with the safe return on government debt.
segments.tr: Các nhà đầu tư mua chứng khoán được đảm bảo bằng thế chấp so sánh lợi nhuận từ các trái phiếu đó với lợi nhuận an toàn từ nợ chính phủ.

segments.src: Lenders then price home loans to deliver a return above that benchmark.
segments.tr: Các bên cho vay sau đó định giá các khoản vay mua nhà để mang lại lợi nhuận cao hơn mức chuẩn đó.

segments.src: The gap between the two is called the mortgage spread.
segments.tr: Khoảng cách giữa hai mức này được gọi là chênh lệch thế chấp.

segments.src: In calmer periods it has historically averaged somewhere around 1.7 percentage points.
segments.tr: Trong những giai đoạn ổn định hơn, mức trung bình lịch sử của nó rơi vào khoảng 1,7 điểm phần trăm.

segments.src: In recent years it has often been wider, because of interest-rate volatility and uncertainty about how quickly borrowers will refinance or move.
segments.tr: Trong những năm gần đây, khoảng cách này thường rộng hơn do sự biến động của lãi suất và sự bất định về tốc độ người đi vay tái cấp vốn hoặc chuyển nhà.

segments.src: A higher Treasury yield plus a wider spread means a higher mortgage rate, even if the central bank holds its policy rate steady.
segments.tr: Lợi suất trái phiếu chính phủ cao hơn cộng với mức chênh lệch rộng hơn có nghĩa là lãi suất thế chấp cao hơn, ngay cả khi ngân hàng trung ương giữ nguyên lãi suất chính sách.

segments.src: ## What is pushing yields up
segments.tr: ## Điều gì đang đẩy lợi suất lên cao

segments.src: Several forces tend to lift long-term yields at the same time:
segments.tr: Một số lực lượng có xu hướng đẩy lợi suất dài hạn lên cùng một lúc:

segments.src: - **Heavy government borrowing.** Large federal deficits mean more Treasury debt for investors to absorb, which can push up the yield needed to attract buyers.
segments.tr: - **Vay mượn chính phủ nặng nề.** Thâm hụt ngân sách liên bang lớn có nghĩa là có nhiều nợ trái phiếu chính phủ hơn để các nhà đầu tư hấp thụ, điều này có thể đẩy lợi suất cần thiết để thu hút người mua lên cao.

segments.src: - **Sticky inflation.** If price growth cools more slowly than expected, investors demand more compensation for holding long-term bonds.
segments.tr: - **Lạm phát cứng đầu.** Nếu tốc độ tăng giá hạ nhiệt chậm hơn dự kiến, các nhà đầu tư đòi hỏi mức bù đắp cao hơn khi nắm giữ trái phiếu dài hạn.

segments.src: - **A "higher for longer" policy outlook.** When markets expect the Fed to keep rates elevated, longer-term yields adjust upward.
segments.tr: - **Triển vọng chính sách "cao hơn trong thời gian dài hơn".** Khi thị trường kỳ vọng Fed giữ lãi suất ở mức cao, lợi suất dài hạn sẽ điều chỉnh tăng lên.

segments.src: - **A larger term premium.** Investors may ask for extra yield to cover the risk of holding long-dated debt amid economic and political uncertainty.
segments.tr: - **Phí hạn chót lớn hơn.** Các nhà đầu tư có thể yêu cầu thêm lợi suất để bù đắp rủi ro nắm giữ nợ kỳ hạn dài trong bối cảnh bất ổn kinh tế và chính trị.

segments.src: No single factor explains the move, and analysts disagree about how much weight each one deserves.
segments.tr: Không có một yếu tố đơn lẻ nào giải thích được sự thay đổi này, và các nhà phân tích không đồng tình về mức độ trọng số mà mỗi yếu tố xứng đáng nhận được.

segments.src: ## The squeeze on buyers
segments.tr: ## Áp lực đối với người mua

segments.src: For buyers, the arithmetic is unforgiving.
segments.tr: Đối với người mua, phép toán không có sự dung thứ.

segments.tr: Hãy xem xét khoản vay 400.000 đô la cho thế chấp cố định 30 năm, chỉ tính gốc và lãi:

segments.src: | Mortgage rate | Approx. monthly payment |
segments.tr: | Mortgage rate | Approx. monthly payment |

segments.src: Going from 3% to 7% adds close to $1,000 a month on the same loan.
segments.tr: Tăng từ 3% lên 7% làm tăng gần 1.000 đô la một tháng cho cùng một khoản vay.

segments.src: Taxes, insurance and maintenance come on top of that.
segments.tr: Thuế, bảo hiểm và chi phí bảo dưỡng được tính thêm vào đó.

segments.src: Many households that qualified comfortably a few years ago now find the numbers don't work, or they shop for a smaller home, a different neighborhood or a longer commute.
segments.tr: Nhiều hộ gia đình đủ điều kiện thoải mái vài năm trước giờ thấy các con số không khả thi, hoặc họ tìm mua một ngôi nhà nhỏ hơn, một khu 33 vực khác hoặc đi làm xa hơn.

segments.src: Common responses among buyers include:
segments.tr: Các phản ứng phổ biến của người mua bao gồm:

segments.src: - **Rethinking the budget.** Some buyers now plan around the monthly payment instead of the headline price.
segments.tr: - **Suy nghĩ lại về ngân sách.** Một số người mua hiện lập kế hoạch dựa trên khoản thanh toán hàng tháng thay vì giá niêm yết.

segments.src: - **Larger down payments.** Putting more money down reduces the loan amount and the interest paid over time.
segments.tr: - **Khoản trả trước lớn hơn.** Đặt cọc nhiều tiền hơn giúp giảm số tiền vay và tiền lãi phải trả theo thời gian.

segments.src: - **Adjustable-rate mortgages.** These offer lower initial rates but carry the risk of higher payments later. Borrowers should read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - **Thế chấp có điều chỉnh lãi suất.** Các khoản này cung cấp lãi suất ban đầu thấp hơn nhưng mang rủi ro thanh toán cao hơn sau này. Người đi vay nên đọc kỹ các điều khoản.

segments.src: - **Waiting.** Some renters are staying put until rates ease, though waiting has its own costs if prices or rents keep rising.
segments.tr: - **Chờ đợi.** Một số người thuê nhà vẫn ở yên cho đến khi lãi suất giảm, mặc dù việc chờ đợi có cái giá riêng nếu giá nhà hoặc tiền thuê nhà tiếp tục tăng.

segments.src: ## The "lock-in effect" and sellers
segments.tr: ## "Hiệu ứng khóa chặt" và người bán

segments.src: Rates also affect the people who already own homes.
segments.tr: Lãi suất cũng ảnh hưởng đến những người đã sở hữu nhà.

segments.src: Millions of owners hold mortgages with rates far below today's levels.
segments.tr: Hàng triệu chủ nhà nắm giữ các khoản thế chấp với lãi suất thấp hơn nhiều so với mức hiện nay.

segments.src: Selling and buying again would mean swapping a cheap loan for an expensive one, so many choose to stay where they are.
segments.tr: Bán nhà và mua lại đồng nghĩa với việc đổi một khoản vay rẻ lấy một khoản vay đắt đỏ, vì vậy nhiều người chọn ở lại vị trí hiện tại.

segments.src: This is often called the lock-in effect.
segments.tr: Điều này thường được gọi là hiệu ứng khóa chặt.

segments.src: It keeps the supply of existing homes for sale unusually low.
segments.tr: Nó giữ nguồn cung nhà hiện có để bán ở mức thấp bất thường.

segments.src: The result is a split market:
segments.tr: Kết quả là một thị trường bị chia rẽ:

segments.src: - **Fewer listings** support prices in many areas, even though demand is weak.
segments.tr: - **Ít danh sách hơn** hỗ trợ giá ở nhiều khu vực, mặc dù nhu cầu yếu.

segments.src: - **Longer time on market** for homes that are priced too high, which pushes some sellers to cut prices or offer concessions.
segments.tr: - **Thời gian trên thị trường lâu hơn** đối với những ngôi nhà có giá quá cao, điều này thúc đẩy một số người bán giảm giá hoặc đưa ra các nhượng bộ.

segments.src: - **Seller-paid incentives**, such as rate buydowns or help with closing costs, have become more common as a way to bring monthly payments down for buyers.
segments.tr: - **Các ưu đãi do người bán trả**, chẳng hạn như hỗ trợ giảm lãi suất hoặc hỗ trợ chi phí đóng sổ, đã trở nên phổ biến hơn như một cách để giảm khoản thanh toán hàng tháng cho người mua.

segments.src: Sellers who must move for work, family or financial reasons face the toughest trade-offs.
segments.tr: Những người bán buộc phải di chuyển vì công việc, gia đình hoặc lý do tài chính phải đối mặt với những sự đánh đổi khó khăn nhất.

segments.src: They may need to price realistically and be flexible on terms.
segments.tr: Họ có thể cần định giá thực tế và linh hoạt về các điều khoản.

segments.src: ## Pressure on builders
segments.tr: ## Áp lực đối với các nhà xây dựng

segments.src: Homebuilders feel the squeeze from both sides.
segments.tr: Các nhà xây dựng nhà ở cảm nhận được áp lực từ cả hai phía.

segments.src: Higher mortgage rates cool demand.
segments.tr: Lãi suất thế chấp cao làm giảm nhu cầu.

segments.src: Meanwhile, builders face their own borrowing costs for land and construction loans, along with the price of labor and materials.
segments.tr: Trong khi đó, các nhà xây dựng phải đối mặt với chi phí vay của chính họ đối với các khoản vay đất đai và xây dựng, cùng với giá nhân công và vật liệu.

segments.src: Because existing-home inventory is so tight, new construction has taken a larger share of the sales that do happen.
segments.tr: Vì hàng tồn kho nhà hiện có quá khan hiếm, các công trình xây dựng mới đã chiếm tỷ trọng lớn hơn trong số các giao dịch thực sự diễn ra.

segments.src: Many builders have responded by:
segments.tr: Nhiều nhà xây dựng đã phản ứng bằng cách:

segments.src: - offering mortgage rate buydowns or closing-cost credits,
segments.tr: - cung cấp hỗ trợ giảm lãi suất thế chấp hoặc tín dụng chi phí đóng sổ,

segments.src: - building smaller, more affordable floor plans,
segments.tr: - xây dựng các sơ đồ mặt bằng nhỏ hơn, giá cả phải chăng hơn,

segments.src: - slowing land purchases and new starts when demand softens.
segments.tr: - làm chậm việc mua đất và khởi công mới khi nhu cầu suy yếu.

segments.src: If high rates persist, slower construction could limit future supply and keep housing costs elevated over the longer term, a trade-off that housing economists continue to debate.
segments.tr: Nếu lãi suất cao tiếp tục kéo dài, việc xây dựng chậm hơn có thể hạn chế nguồn cung trong tương lai và giữ chi phí nhà ở ở mức cao trong dài hạn, một sự đánh đổi mà các nhà kinh tế học nhà ở tiếp tục tranh luận.

segments.src: ## What it means for the broader economy
segments.tr: ## Ý nghĩa đối với nền kinh tế rộng lớn hơn

segments.src: Housing touches a large share of economic activity, from construction jobs and furniture sales to moving services and banking.
segments.tr: Nhà ở chạm đến một phần lớn hoạt động kinh tế, từ việc làm ngành xây dựng và doanh số bán đồ nội thất đến dịch vụ chuyển nhà và ngân hàng.

segments.src: When transactions slow, those sectors feel it.
segments.tr: Khi các giao dịch chậm lại, các lĩnh vực đó sẽ cảm nhận được điều đó.

segments.src: Higher yields also raise borrowing costs for businesses and the government itself, which is one reason policymakers watch long-term rates closely.
segments.tr: Lợi suất cao hơn cũng làm tăng chi phí vay cho các doanh nghiệp và chính phủ, đó là một lý do tại sao các nhà hoạch định chính sách theo dõi chặt chẽ lãi suất dài hạn.

segments.src: At the same time, higher yields are not all bad news.
segments.tr: Đồng thời, lợi suất cao hơn không hoàn toàn là tin xấu.

segments.src: Savers can earn more on Treasury securities, certificates of deposit and high-yield savings accounts.
segments.tr: Người tiết kiệm có thể kiếm được nhiều hơn từ trái phiếu chính phủ, chứng chỉ tiền gửi và tài khoản tiết kiệm có lợi suất cao.

segments.src: Those returns help offset higher costs for some households, particularly retirees who rely on interest income.
segments.tr: Những khoản lợi nhuận đó giúp bù đắp chi phí cao hơn cho một số hộ gia đình, đặc biệt là những người nghỉ hưu dựa vào thu nhập từ lãi suất.

segments.src: ## Practical steps to consider
segments.tr: ## Các bước thực tế cần xem xét

segments.src: Every situation is different, but these general ideas come up often in consumer guidance:
segments.tr: Mọi tình huống đều khác nhau, nhưng những ý tưởng chung này thường xuất hiện trong hướng dẫn người tiêu dùng:

segments.src: 1. **Check your credit.** A higher score can qualify you for a better rate. Review your credit reports for errors before applying.
segments.tr: 1. **Kiểm tra tín dụng của bạn.** Điểm số cao hơn có thể giúp bạn đủ điều kiện nhận lãi suất tốt hơn. Xem lại báo cáo tín dụng để tìm lỗi trước khi nộp đơn.

segments.src: 2. **Compare lenders.** Quotes can differ meaningfully. Ask for a Loan Estimate from several lenders and compare both rates and fees.
segments.tr: 2. **So sánh các bên cho vay.** Các báo giá có thể khác biệt đáng kể. Yêu cầu Dự toán Khoản vay từ một số bên cho vay và so sánh cả lãi suất và phí.

segments.src: 3. **Understand the total cost.** Look at points, closing costs and insurance, not just the interest rate.
segments.tr: 3. **Hiểu tổng chi phí.** Xem xét các điểm, chi phí đóng sổ và bảo hiểm, không chỉ lãi suất.

segments.src: 4. **Ask about refinancing later.** If you buy now and rates fall, you may be able to refinance, but there is no guarantee. Check for fees and make sure the savings justify the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **Hỏi về việc tái cấp vốn sau này.** Nếu bạn mua ngay bây giờ và lãi suất giảm, bạn có thể tái cấp vốn, nhưng không có đảm bảo nào. Kiểm tra các khoản phí và đảm bảo khoản tiết kiệm bù đắp được chi phí.

segments.src: 5. **Keep a cushion.** Make sure you can afford the payment and still have emergency savings.
segments.tr: 5. **Giữ một khoản dự phòng.** Đảm bảo bạn có thể chi trả khoản thanh toán và vẫn có tiền tiết kiệm khẩn cấp.

segments.src: 6. **Talk to a professional.** A housing counselor, mortgage officer or financial adviser can help you weigh your options. HUD-approved housing counselors offer free or low-cost guidance in the United States.
segments.tr: 6. **Nói chuyện với chuyên gia.** Cố vấn nhà ở, nhân viên thế chấp hoặc cố vấn tài chính có thể giúp bạn cân nhắc các lựa chọn của mình. Các cố vấn nhà ở được HUD phê duyệt cung cấp hướng dẫn miễn phí hoặc chi phí thấp tại Hoa Kỳ.

segments.src: ## What to watch this fall
segments.tr: ## Những điều cần theo dõi vào mùa thu này

segments.src: - **Inflation reports.** Cooler readings could ease pressure on yields. Hotter ones could add to it.
segments.tr: - **Báo cáo lạm phát.** Các số liệu hạ nhiệt có thể giảm bớt áp lực lên lợi suất. Các số liệu nóng hơn có thể làm tăng thêm áp lực.

segments.src: - **Federal Reserve meetings.** Statements about the future path of rates often move the bond market.
segments.tr: - **Các cuộc họp của Cục Dự trữ Liên bang.** Các tuyên bố về lộ trình tương lai của lãi suất thường làm thị trường trái phiếu chuyển động.

segments.src: - **Treasury auctions and deficit news.** Demand for government debt influences yields.
segments.tr: - **Đấu giá trái phiếu chính phủ và tin tức thâm hụt.** Nhu cầu về nợ chính phủ ảnh hưởng đến lợi suất.

segments.src: - **Existing-home sales and builder sentiment.** These show whether buyers are adapting or pulling back.
segments.tr: - **Doanh số bán nhà hiện có và tâm lý nhà xây dựng.** Những điều này cho thấy liệu người mua đang thích nghi hay đang rút lui.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: A 10-year Treasury yield above 5% is a reminder that mortgage rates are shaped by forces well beyond any one lender or homebuyer.
segments.tr: Lợi suất trái phiếu chính phủ kỳ hạn 10 năm trên 5% là một lời nhắc nhở rằng lãi suất thế chấp được định hình bởi các lực lượng vượt xa bất kỳ người cho vay hoặc người mua nhà đơn lẻ nào.

segments.src: For now, elevated yields are keeping borrowing costs high, holding many owners in place and testing builders' margins.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, lợi suất tăng cao đang giữ chi phí đi vay ở mức cao, giữ chân nhiều chủ nhà tại chỗ và kiểm tra biên lợi nhuận của các nhà xây dựng.

segments.src: No one can say for sure when conditions will change, and forecasts have a mixed record.
segments.tr: Không ai có thể nói chắc chắn khi nào điều kiện sẽ thay đổi, và các dự báo có thành tích hỗn hợp.

segments.src: The most useful approach for most households is to focus on what they can control: their budget, their credit and their time horizon.
segments.tr: Phương pháp hữu ích nhất đối với hầu hết các hộ gia đình là tập trung vào những gì họ có thể kiểm soát: ngân sách, tín dụng và thời hạn của họ.
